name: @vousoir/workspace-root
description: Private root of the Vousoir pnpm workspace. Not published; holds the shared toolchain and the enforcement scripts (lint, dep-check, typecheck, test) that gate every Vousoir-layer package. code-oss's own npm-driven build at the repo root is separate and untouched.

scripts.//lint: Run from the REPO ROOT with an explicit --config: ESLint 9 flat config refuses to lint files outside its config file's base path, and the Vousoir layer spans typings/, vousoir/, and extensions/. --config also stops ESLint picking up code-oss's own root eslint.config.js (§7.4: upstream lint stays untouched). vousoir/boundary-tests/src is the WP-E fixture-proving harness (§9.9/§9.10); only src/ is listed, never boundary-tests/fixtures/ — that's what keeps its deliberately-broken fixtures out of a normal run.
scripts.lint: cd .. && eslint --config vousoir/eslint.config.mjs typings/vousoir vousoir/shared vousoir/services extensions/vousoir-core vousoir/boundary-tests/src
scripts.lint:strict: cd .. && eslint --config vousoir/eslint.config.mjs --max-warnings=0 typings/vousoir vousoir/shared vousoir/services extensions/vousoir-core vousoir/boundary-tests/src
scripts.lint:fix: cd .. && eslint --config vousoir/eslint.config.mjs --fix typings/vousoir vousoir/shared vousoir/services extensions/vousoir-core vousoir/boundary-tests/src
scripts.//dep-check: -x excludes vousoir/services/__ci-fixtures__, the WP-E quarantined cross-service-import fixture (§9.9) — it must not fail the normal boundary sweep. vousoir/boundary-tests/src/cross-service-import.test.ts invokes depcruise directly, without this flag, to prove the fixture IS caught when the exclusion is lifted.
scripts.dep-check: cd .. && depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs -x "(^|/)__ci-fixtures__(/|$)" --output-type err typings/vousoir vousoir/shared vousoir/services extensions/vousoir-core vousoir/boundary-tests/src
scripts.dep-check:graph: cd .. && depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs -x "(^|/)__ci-fixtures__(/|$)" --output-type dot typings/vousoir vousoir/shared vousoir/services extensions/vousoir-core vousoir/boundary-tests/src
scripts.verify: pnpm run lint:strict && pnpm run dep-check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
